d:
Get ready to fall in love all over again with the romantic movie "Jab We Met" starring Shahid Kapoor and Kareena Kapoor Khan in stunning 4K quality! Watch now for a cinematic experience like never before.
Aditya, a heartbroken tycoon on the verge of committing suicide, aimlessly boards a train. He meets Geet, a bubbly girl who plans to elope with her lover, and finds himself pulled into her crazy life.
Jab We Met is a 2007 Indian Hindi-language romantic comedy film written and directed by Imtiaz Ali.
